item.title: Why Mario inspired me to poke around genetic regex evolution
item.description:
Can a Computer Evolve Its Own Detection Rules?

Teaching a machine to evolve it’s own regex patterns that catch obfuscated PowerShell

Prologue: a video, eleven years ago

The inspiration for this project was drawn many moons ago from a YouTube video: MarI/O (SethBling, 2015 - youtube.com/watch?v=qv6UVOQ0F44). In it, a computer is handed the controls to Super Mario World and told that getting further to the right is good, but nothing about enemies, jumping, or how the game works. Initially it simply twitches, confused and lost and subsequently dies on the first Goomba. After thousands of attempts across many generations, keeping and combining whatever iterations managed to make it little further. Eventually with enough generations, it plays the level. Nobody programmed it to do this. It evolved the skill.

item.title: Provenance-based Graph Neural Networks using Heterogeneous Graph Transformers - Part 2
item.description:
Provenance-based Graph Neural Networks using Heterogeneous Graph Transformers - Part 2

In this post we directly continue from Part 1 (https://blog.pr0kythera.com/posts/new-post-here/), we ended up with: a single minimal test HGT (hetrogeneous graph transformer) which worked but could tell us nothing besides the pipeline was a success, and three hopes and dreams: more scenarios, a temporal feature, and an A/B test of the three-scope idea against a single GNN (the control) to determine if my hypothesis that 3 differently scoped approaches out performs a single GNN that looks over the entire graph.

item.title: Building the worlds worst Machine Learning Detection engine
item.description:
Background

This year, 2026 to alleviate any doubt, I have set myself the ambition to focus on tangibly improving at Machine Learning and Reverse Engineering. Both are topics i’ve studied in my career and during my university degree. However I feel like I do not have as much knowledge of as I would like.

Unfortunately with anything unless you’re constantly exercising with an aim to improve and deepen your abilities at best you stagnate, at worst the knowledge slowly starts fading away. So how can I achieve this and where can I start?
